title: Colours and materials

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Choose contrast for the actual sign material so information remains readable in its environment.
strategic_value: A mostly black-and-white signage palette can make Helsinki information consistent across varied building finishes.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture places material and contrast guidance above black and white circular swatches.
practical_value: Start with black or white, then evaluate contrast against the selected physical surface before considering other palette colors.

content_islands.name: Material guidance
content_islands.spec: Keep the default-color advice and location-dependent material choice together.

content_islands.name: Neutral swatches
content_islands.spec: Pair the black and white discs as the primary signage options.

ingredient.name: Signage color contrast
ingredient.role: Keep wayfinding legible against its material.
ingredient.application: Generally use black and/or white; use other palette colors carefully and ensure sufficient contrast.
ingredient.scope: Signs; evaluate the actual building or location material.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links black/white use and adequate contrast to clarity, readability and accessibility.
reference_purposes.Application: It ties sign materials to the building or location.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Other palette colors require careful use with accessibility in mind; black/white is the general default.
